shots.focal_element: Centered two-line headline 'A New Era of / Craft & Quality' over a grainy magenta-orange-blue gradient, with heavily motion-blurred 3D UI cards entering from the frame edges.
on_screen_text: A New Era of Craft & Quality
shots.typography: Geometric sans, white; small medium-weight first line 'A New Era of' above a larger semibold 'Craft & Quality'; title case, tight tracking, center aligned. Low-opacity ClickUp wordmark bottom-right. Font guess (low confidence): Plus Jakarta Sans-like.
shots.what_happens: Opening frames of the card-ring sequence: thick glass/metal-rimmed phone-like UI cards fly in from the corners with strong motion blur while the headline sits static in the center; VO is on 'craft' (w79). Only 0.23 s long, likely a detector split inside one continuous move.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a grain-textured radial gradient, put a static centered two-line headline and animate 8-12 rounded 3D UI-screenshot cards from off-screen corners inward along curved paths with motion blur, as the start of an orbiting ring.
